PUBLIC_BANK_CAR.title: Public Bank passenger-vehicle margins and tenures
PUBLIC_BANK_CAR.summary: Passenger vehicles up to five years old: up to 90% financing and 108 months. Older vehicle bands shorten tenure; over ten and up to twelve years: up to 75% and 36 months. Maxima remain subject to bank approval. Internal DSR rules and actual approval probabilities are not supplied.

MAYBANK_CAR.title: Maybank Hire Purchase framework
MAYBANK_CAR.summary: Maybank adopted reducing-balance hire-purchase calculations from 1 August 2026. Passenger-car financing is up to 90% and 108 months; used-car terms depend on vehicle age. Both fixed and variable rates use remaining balance. Final terms remain subject to approval.

CIMB_HOME.title: CIMB HomeFlexi Smart
CIMB_HOME.summary: Combined financing can reach 95%, inclusive of eligible insurance, legal and valuation costs capped at 5%. Tenure: five to 35 years or age 70, whichever comes first. The demo's 90% asset-only cap is a conservative planning assumption. Commission and self-employed applicants need additional evidence.

MAYBANK_HOME.title: Maybank MaxiHome
MAYBANK_HOME.summary: MaxiHome lists tenure up to 35 years or age 70 and combined financing up to 95% including related capitalised expenses. Additional property and income documents may be required. Actual asset-only margin needs bank confirmation; the demo uses a conservative 90% planning assumption.

MAYBANK_PERSONAL.title: Maybank personal loan requirements
MAYBANK_PERSONAL.summary: Malaysian citizenship, entry age 21-60 and monthly gross income at least RM3,500. Amount RM5,000-RM100,000, tenure two-six years. Quotation rate and calculation basis must be verified. The demo rates are illustrative, not live bank offers.

CIMB_PERSONAL.title: CIMB Cash Plus personal loan requirements
CIMB_PERSONAL.summary: Malaysian citizens aged 21-58, maturity no later than age 60, minimum monthly gross income RM2,000. Employment exceeds six consecutive months; self-employed business history exceeds 24 months. Amount RM2,000-RM100,000, terms two-seven years, stamp duty 0.5%. Lowest advertised pricing requires specific eligibility.

BNM_PERSONAL.title: BNM Personal Financing policy effective dates
BNM_PERSONAL.summary: Issued 30 September 2025. Specified provisions on tenure, flat-rate/Rule of 78 prohibition, effective-rate disclosure and financial education take effect 1 January 2027. Financial education concerns new personal financing above RM100,000. Do not treat future provisions as already effective. Supported demo personal products stop at RM100,000.

BNM_HOUSING.title: BNM third housing financing LTV cap
BNM_HOUSING.summary: The 2010 measure caps the third housing financing facility at 70% LTV. The demo checks existing outstanding housing facilities before applying it. It does not assume first or second mortgages automatically receive 90% financing.

BNM_CCRIS.title: BNM CCRIS questions
BNM_CCRIS.summary: CCRIS supplies credit information and repayment records; BNM does not issue a credit rating or blacklist. Rejected applications are not included in CCRIS. Do not advertise a guaranteed CCRIS rejection-footprint shield. This demo neither connects to CCRIS nor creates official reports.

PDPA.title: Malaysia Personal Data Protection Commissioner FAQ
PDPA.summary: Identifiable data used commercially can engage PDPA duties for notice, disclosure, security, retention, accuracy and access. Mock-only controls do not certify real-data deployment. Profiling, cross-border processing, DPO, breach notification and credit-reporting roles need separate legal and operational review.
